company.name: UPSIDE Foods
company.shortDescription: UPSIDE Foods is a food tech company that produces and grows sustainable cultured meat.
company.description:
UPSIDE Foods (formerly known as Memphis Meats) develops meat produced directly from animal cells without the need to raise and slaughter actual animals. This approach requires significantly less water, land, and energy than conventional meat production, enabling consumers to enjoy meat that is clean, humane, and free of harmful chemicals.

Co-founded and led by Dr. Uma Valeti in 2015, UPSIDE Foods is headquartered in Berkeley, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: UPSIDE Foods is researching methods for producing comestible food bases from expended cell culture media, comestible cell-based meat products comprising dry cell powder, and nutrient media formulations for slaughter-free meat. They are developing systems for sterilizing bioreactors with superheated water, harvesting cell-based meat, and using filter cake-based and pipe-based bioreactor systems. Their work also includes plant fat-based scaffolds and methods for forming cell-based meat fibers and fillets.
